This is a premium social media SaaS application inspired by Twitter, Threads, Linear, and Vercel.

Design principles:
- Human-made feel
- Editorial spacing
- Typography-first UI
- Subtle surfaces
- Dark elegant theme
- Minimal visual noise
- No generic Tailwind dashboard aesthetics
- No random gradients
- No oversized cards
- No neon cyberpunk style

Tech:
- React
- TailwindCSS
- Framer Motion
- Lucide Icons

Rules:
- Preserve functionality
- Preserve routes
- Modify UI only unless explicitly asked
- Prefer component reuse
- Maintain responsive layout
- Improve spacing rhythm and visual hierarchy
